item.title: Wheel it up and Make it Glow
item.description:
I’m psyched to be co-leading a workshop at the Steelyard this Spring! It’ll be a hoot, as co-host and friend Dave would say. Speaking of Dave, here’s a picture of his DJing cart.

If you’re in or around Providence, and have any friends who would love to participate in this workshop, please share this post (or even better, the actual landing page) with them! Limited scholarships are also available.

item.title: Infinite Composition by Leo Villareal
item.description:
I finally got a chance to head over to Brown University’s Lindemann Performing Arts Center to see ‘Infinite Composition‘, a white LED installation that has been in the building lobby since Fall 2023.

I became a fan of Villareal’s work via an accompanying soundtrack that was used in his installation in the National Gallery of Art in Washington DC. This sountrack mix was created by James Healy, who along with DJ Olive created one of my favorite record labels of all time, The Agriculture. I originally found The Agriculture and DJ Olive in my freshman year of college as a burgeoning avant-garde/new music fan; I can’t remember who the exact collaborators were at this moment, but he was a turntablist who definitely wasn’t afraid of dipping his toes in more adventurous musics.

item.title: BSR Live
item.description:
With bittersweet emotions, after 12 years of DJing/programming, I recently left Brown Student and Community Radio, aka BSR Live.

The BSR that I joined in 2010 was a freeform radio force to be reckoned with. We had a full 7-day schedule with a truly diverse collection of shows: K-pop, film music, experimental, an Atheism show, psychedelic folk, new classical, live electronic mix shows, a show about local Providence music, punk..the list goes on.

item.title: Three Nights of Lights
item.description:
The big LED matrix I made for Wooly Fair will be made an appearance in downtown Providence this weekend care of the Avenue Concept , as part of the Three Nights of Lights Festival.

We were at 35 Weybosset Street on the evening of 12/1 and on Matthewson Street on the evening of 12/2, as part of the Avenue Concept roster of events.

Lots of amazing art, performance, and smiles on both nights. And of course, plenty of lights!
